post.summary: Load the demo: Kestrel Works, about sixty people in four levels with dotted lines, vacancies, deputies and roles, and its processes.
post.description: The organisation goes only into an installation without units; the processes only into one without processes whose organisation is the demo's. Each goes in once, all of it or nothing, and asked again with nothing left to load the demo is refused. The suite realm's alice, bob, carol and dave are in it by address, so their first sign-in links them.

get.description: kind is units, positions, people or holdings; asOf is a day written 2006-01-02, today when left out. Rows name each other by ref, the id; units come parents first; holdings are those of the positions exported that have not ended by then, planned ones too.

get.summary: Where people are missing, or too many, over a range: vacant seats, capacity under or over target, and roles nobody or only one person holds, earliest first.
get.description: from and to are days written 2006-01-02, both counted; from is today when left out and to thirteen weeks on, at most 731 days. unitId keeps to a unit, with subUnits=true to the units placed under it on some day of the range too; left out, the whole organisation. Each gap is a run of days of one size; a unit's target is compared with the unit counted with its sub-units.

get.description: from and to are days written 2006-01-02, both counted; from is today when left out and to thirteen weeks on. Planned holdings, leavers and archived positions count on their days. issuer and subject name the person. Only the person, those above them in the management chain today and editors see it.

get.summary: Search people, positions, units, roles, processes and the steps of processes, grouped by kind, best first.
get.description: q needs two letters or more; every word is found as the start of a word, ignoring case and accents, a description's words also stemmed in English and German, and a name typed with a slip by its likeness. A name that is what was typed comes first. asOf, a day written 2006-01-02, today when left out, keeps to the people, positions and units there on that day; steps are those of the newest published version, or of the draft of a process not published yet. limit caps each kind, 10 when left out, at most 50. A step's id is its process's, with stepKey and version naming it there.
